findings.summary: H1 (FIXED): importRow parse errors had no column-header context; user saw 'Invalid value: abc' with no indication which field failed. Fixed: wrapped ExcelValueCodec.parse() in try/catch, rethrown as IAE with ann.header() prefix.
M2 (FIXED): COLUMN_COUNT = 9 was a magic number; silent column loss if TourExcelRow gains a field. Fixed: replaced with Arrays.stream().filter(@ExcelColumn).count() — self-syncs with the DTO.
L1 (FIXED): Tests 6+7 asserted only error().isNotBlank() — too weak after H1 added column header. Fixed: strengthened to containsIgnoringCase('Departure Date') and containsIgnoringCase('Price').
